(Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF APRIL 24, 2018
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of April 24, 2018.
A-1 Minutes 4-24-18 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
INTRODUCTION AND CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, CALIFORNIA, REPEALING CHAPTER 5.36 (MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS) OF TITLE 5 (BUSINESS REGULATION AND LICENSES) AND ADDING SECTION 10.50.210 (MASSAGE REGULATIONS) TO CHAPTER 10.50 (STANDARDS FOR SPECIFIC LAND USES AND ACTIVITIES) OF ARTICLE 4 (REGULATIONS FOR SPECIFIC LAND USE ACTIVITIES) OF TITLE 10 (ZONING), AND AMENDING SECTIONS 10.132.140 ("M" DEFINITIONS) AND 10.132.170 ("P" DEFINITIONS) OF CHAPTER 10.132 DEFINITIONS OF TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ESTABLISH REGULATIONS FOR MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS IN THE CITY, AND NOTICE OF EXEMPTION REGARDING SAME
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and take public testimony; (2) waive reading of Ordinance No. 18-956 and read by title only; (3) introduce Ordinance No. 18-956, an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente repealing chapter 5.36 (Massage Establishments) of Title 5 (Business Regulation and Licenses) and adding section 10.50.210 (Massage Regulations) to Chapter 10.50 (Standards for Specific Land Uses and Activities) of Article 4 (Regulations for Specific Land Use Activities) of Title 10 (Zoning), and amending Sections 10.132.140 ("M" Definitions) and 10.132.170 ("P" Definitions) of chapter 10.132 Definitions of Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code to establish regulations for massage establishments in the city, and present the Notice of Exemption.
B-1 Massage Regulations Staff Report
B-1 Massage Regulations Attachment A Ordinance
B-1 Massage Regulations Attachment B NOE
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1450
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 18-5415 approving Warrant Register No. 1450.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1450
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE 2018 EDITION OF THE STANDARD SPECIFICATIONS FOR PUBLIC WORKS CONSTRUCTION
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5416 adopting the 2018 Edition of the Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction.
D-2 2018 Green Book Adoption Staff Report
D-2 2018 Green Book Adoption Attachment A Resolution
D-3
PRESENTATION OF THE FY 2017-2018 THIRD QUARTER INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-3 FY 17-18 Third Quarter Investment Report Staff Report
D-3 FY 17-18 Third Quarter Investment Report Attachments A-D
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A LIABILITY AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOR THE COUNTYWIDE HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTE COLLECTION EVENT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Countywide Household Hazardous Waste Collection Program Siting Liability Agreement; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
D-4 Household Hazardous Waste Staff Report
D-4 Household Hazardous Waste Attachment A Agreement
D-5
CONSIDERATION AND AWARD OF EDUCATION SCHOLARSHIPS FOR FY 2018-2019
It is recommended by the Education Commission that the City Council award seventeen scholarships for the 2018-2019 academic year in the amount of $500 each.

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
